title: GovernWorld enterprise policy (chrome.storage.managed)
description: Administrator policy for managed browsers. Absent entirely for consumer users. A present-but-invalid policy locks the UI and applies maximum protection rather than falling back to user control.

protectionMode.title: Enforced paste-protection coverage
protectionMode.description: off: no interception. this-tab: tabs the user explicitly authorizes. always-on: every visited page once site access is granted.

userCanDisable.title: User may change or disable protection
userCanDisable.description: When false (default under management), the user cannot change the mode or mandated categories.

enforcedCategories.title: Mandated detection categories
enforcedCategories.description: Categories the user cannot disable. Merged with (never subtracted from) user-enabled categories.
